abstract: Operating guide for Hugging Face: the hf CLI for tokens, download, upload and cache, Inference Providers through router.huggingface.co with provider policies and billing routes, and Inference Endpoints (hardware, deploy, scale, pause, scale-to-zero behavior, delete), with Spaces and Jobs covered briefly. Includes LiteLLM wiring, teardown and troubleshooting. Checked against the official Hugging Face docs and the live router model list on 2026-10-11; exact rate limits and personal spend caps are marked unverified.
